readerCopy.body: The person with the biggest answer may be least equipped to understand the part of the problem that hurt. When Jupiter opposes Chiron, confidence, expertise, or an expansive solution can sit across from lived experience that does not fit the optimistic version cleanly. Advice may be broadly useful and still miss the cost, history, or vulnerability that changes what is practical for you. Do not reject a helpful opportunity just because it came with an oversimplified explanation. Keep the part that works and insist that the plan account for what you already know from experience.
